rationale: This sociological article examines European bureaucratization and street-level administrative practices using the Common European Asylum System (specifically the Dublin procedure) as its case. It has no connection to water or sanitation service access (fails C1 and C4; E01 wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both readings yield exclude (E01): although the article discusses cross-border administrative routines and bureaucratization in the Common European Asylum System, it is entirely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Zur Soziologie der Bürokratisierung Europas am Beispiel des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Asylsystems

Die Erörterungen, die sich am Fall des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Asylsystems orientieren, zeigen, dass bestehende nationale Verwaltungspraktiken verschränkt und grenzüberschreitende Verfahrensabläufe etabliert werden.
